title: Subject Societies and Student-Led Discipline Communities
summary: Strengthens subject societies as student-led conveners of disciplinary identity, belonging, opportunity, alumni connection and peer community. This proposition is deferred pending a student-led support and funding decision.
problemSolved: King's has strong subject societies, but they are not yet systematically supported as part of the graduate premium ecology.
whatChanges: Subject societies become better supported as discipline-level conveners while preserving student-led independence.

components.title: Discipline-level community
components.summary: Strengthen belonging and intellectual identity within disciplines.

components.title: Alumni and employer connection
components.summary: Create routes to speakers, employer contacts, mentoring and sector insight.

components.title: Department and Careers links
components.summary: Connect societies more consistently with departments, Careers, Alumni and opportunity growth.

components.title: Student leadership support
components.summary: Support society leaders as conveners, hosts, connectors and peer leaders.

deliveryDisposition: deferred; no new mobilisation funding assumed
